verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is an agent product, so being an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. However, all the MCP evidence describes the opposite role: Computer acting as an MCP server that external clients such as Claude connect to. Nothing in the pack shows users plugging their own MCP servers into Computer. The managed 400+ service connector framework is a related but different feature, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
